notes.title: Very important bugs fixed ! Patch 1.5.10
notes.content:
I am aware of a lot of frustrating of even game blocking bugs that some players have experienced during the first 2 weeks of launch, including the worst ones :

- Not being able to create an account
- Not being able to log in
- Not seeing one's items
- Being blocked out of the game after failing a trial several times in a row
- Multiplayer lobbies not working well
- Not having a game registered and rewarded

[u][b]I want you to know that I am really sorry and all those bugs have been fixed ![/b][/u]

Please know that I am working every day as hard as I can to make this game better and better, and if I sometimes leave or even add a bug, [b]you can always find me on [url=https://discord.gg/trc8EfFY]Discord[/url] and you can expect swift fixes[/b] ! 

I hope you give it another try even if you are amongst those who experienced those bugs <3

Hypno
